subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` inside shared user/workspace path resolvers, or should env interpolation stay limited to config-load and dotenv semantics?
rationale: The code change is mechanically small, but it changes shared path/config behavior for existing users and overlaps the broader dotenv expansion policy tracked separately.

options.title: Adopt resolver expansion
options.body: Land or replace the linked resolver-level fix with regression coverage for configured workspaces, `OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR`, and ClawHub skill install targets.

options.title: Keep interpolation at config load
options.body: Fix only the config/dotenv path that is supposed to receive already-expanded values and document that path resolvers do not perform env interpolation.

options.title: Defer to dotenv policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and linked until the broader dotenv/env-expansion contract is decided, then apply the same rule here.

recommendation.title: Adopt resolver expansion
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked resolver-level fix with regression coverage for configured workspaces, `OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR`, and ClawHub skill install targets.
